newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA'S JIANGSU ITIC UNIT MANDATES US$30 MLN FRN.
newsitem.headline: CHINA'S JIANGSU ITIC UNIT MANDATES US$30 MLN FRN.

text.p: Broadsino Investment Co Ltd (BIC) has mandated Natexis Banque-BFCE to arrange a US$30 million secured floating rate notes issue, the arranger said.
The notes have a final maturity of three years.
There will be a letter of comfort from Jiangsu International Trust and Investment Corp (JITIC).
An arranger group is being formed.
General syndication is expected at the end of the month.
BIC was incorporated in Hong Kong. It is a unit of Jiangsu provincial government-controlled JITIC, the largest provincial trust and investment corporation in China.
